name: Payment Transaction 169
definition: Provides further details on the original transactions, to which the status report message refers.

StatusIdentification.name: Status Identification
StatusIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by an instructing party for an instructed party, to unambiguously identify the reported status.|Usage: The instructing party is the party sending the status message and not the party that sent the original instruction that is being reported on.

OriginalInstructionIdentification.name: Original Instruction Identification
OriginalInstructionIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the original instructing party for the original instructed party, to unambiguously identify the original instruction.

OriginalEndToEndIdentification.name: Original End To End Identification
OriginalEndToEndIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the original initiating party, to unambiguously identify the original transaction.

OriginalUETR.name: Original UETR
OriginalUETR.definition: Universally unique identifier to provide the original end-to-end reference of a payment transaction.

TransactionStatus.name: Transaction Status
TransactionStatus.definition: Specifies the status of a transaction, as published in an external payment transaction status code list.

StatusReasonInformation.name: Status Reason Information
StatusReasonInformation.definition: Provides detailed information on the status reason.

PaymentConditionStatus.name: Payment Condition Status
PaymentConditionStatus.definition: Status related to the requested conditions for the execution of the payment.

ChargesInformation.name: Charges Information
ChargesInformation.definition: Provides information on the charges related to the processing of the rejection of the instruction.|Usage: This is passed on for information purposes only. Settlement of the charges will be done separately.

DebtorDecisionDateTime.name: Debtor Decision Date Time
DebtorDecisionDateTime.definition: Date and time on when the debtor has accepted or rejected the request.

AcceptanceDateTime.name: Acceptance Date Time
AcceptanceDateTime.definition: Point in time when the payment order from the initiating party meets the processing conditions of the account servicing agent. This means that the account servicing agent has received the payment order and has applied checks such as authorisation, availability of funds.

AccountServicerReference.name: Account Servicer Reference
AccountServicerReference.definition: Unique reference, as assigned by the account servicing institution, to unambiguously identify the instruction.

ClearingSystemReference.name: Clearing System Reference
ClearingSystemReference.definition: Unique reference, as assigned by a clearing system, to unambiguously identify the instruction.

OriginalTransactionReference.name: Original Transaction Reference
OriginalTransactionReference.definition: Key elements used to identify the original transaction that is being referred to.

EnclosedFile.name: Enclosed File
EnclosedFile.definition: Document or template enclosed in the notification.||Usage: The use of the EnclosedFile element must be bilaterally agreed.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
